context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 41 verified Auto Quality Preset feature. Four presets available: auto (AI resolves based on length/template), draft (0 iterations, skips SERP+optimization), standard (max 3 iterations), premium (max 10 iterations). Auto resolution rules: pillar_page template OR target_length>=2500 → premium, target_length<=800 → draft, else → standard. Frontend shows 4 preset cards with data-testid='quality-preset-{auto|draft|standard|premium}'. Auto is selected by default with green border (#059669). During generation, if qualityPreset=auto, UI shows notice 'AI wybrała: {preset} — {reason}' (data-testid='generation-auto-preset-notice'). Status endpoint returns resolved_preset and preset_reason fields when job completes.

status_endpoint_fields.resolved_preset: The preset that auto resolved to (draft|standard|premium)
